def cleanup_old_uploaded_files():
    try:
        import glob
        current_time = pendulum.now()
        file_age_limit = pendulum.duration(days=7)
        upload_folder = app.config['UPLOAD_FOLDER']
        files = glob.glob(os.path.join(upload_folder, '*'))
        removed_count = 0
        
        for filepath in files:
            if os.path.isfile(filepath):
                file_mtime = pendulum.from_timestamp(os.path.getmtime(filepath))
                if current_time - file_mtime > file_age_limit:
                    os.remove(filepath)
                    removed_count += 1
                    logger.info(f"Deleted old file: {filepath}")
        
        if removed_count > 0:
            logger.info(f"File cleanup completed: removed {removed_count} files")
    except Exception as e:

tag app
	prop sessionId = "session_" + Date.now()
	prop messages = []
	prop chats = []
	prop inputText = ""
	prop sidebarActive = no
	prop ctxVisible = no
	prop currentFile = null
	prop reportData = null
	prop overlayActive = no
	prop activeTasks = new Set()

	def mount
		const canvas = $canvasBg
		const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas, alpha: no})
		renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight)
		window.addEventListener('resize') do renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight)
		
		const vertexShader = "varying vec2 vUv;void main(){vUv=uv;gl_Position=projectionMatrix*modelViewMatrix*vec4(position,1.0);}"
		const fragmentShader = "uniform float time;varying vec2 vUv;vec3 mod289(vec3 x){return x-floor(x*(1.0/289.0))*289.0;}vec2 mod289(vec2 x){return x-floor(x*(1.0/289.0))*289.0;}vec3 permute(vec3 x){return mod289(((x*34.0)+1.0)*x);}float snoise(vec2 v){const vec4 C=vec4(0.211324865405187,0.366025403784439,-0.577350269189626,0.024390243902439);vec2 i=floor(v+dot(v,C.yy));vec2 x0=v-i+dot(i,C.xx);vec2 i1=(x0.x>x0.y)?vec2(1.0,0.0):vec2(0.0,1.0);vec4 x12=x0.xyxy+C.xxzz;x12.xy-=i1;i=mod289(i);vec3 p=permute(permute(i.y+vec3(0.0,i1.y,1.0))+i.x+vec3(0.0,i1.x,1.0));vec3 m=max(0.5-vec3(dot(x0,x0),dot(x12.xy,x12.xy),dot(x12.zw,x12.zw)),0.0);m=m*m;m=m*m;vec3 x=2.0*fract(p*C.www)-1.0;vec3 h=abs(x)-0.5;vec3 ox=floor(x+0.5);vec3 a0=x-ox;m*=1.79284291400159-0.85373472095314*(a0*a0+h*h);vec3 g;g.x=a0.x*x0.x+h.x*x0.y;g.yz=a0.yz*x12.xz+h.yz*x12.yw;return 130.0*dot(m,g);}void main(){float t=time*0.2;vec3 c1=vec3(0.02,0.02,0.05);vec3 c2=vec3(0.0,0.05,0.2);vec3 c3=vec3(0.0,0.0,0.0);vec3 c4=vec3(0.04,0.5,1.0);float n1=snoise(vUv*2.0+vec2(t*0.5,t*0.2));float n2=snoise(vUv*3.0-vec2(t*0.3,t*0.8));vec3 color=mix(c1,c2,n1);color=mix(color,c3,smoothstep(0.3,0.8,n2));float lines=sin(vUv.y*20.0+n1*5.0+time);color+=c4*0.03*smoothstep(0.95,1.0,lines);gl_FragColor=vec4(color,1.0);}"
		
		const scene = new THREE.Scene()
		const camera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1,1,1,-1,0,1)
		const uniforms = {time: {value: 0}}
		const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({vertexShader, fragmentShader, uniforms})
		scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2,2), material))
		
		const animate = do |t|
			uniforms.time.value = t * 0.001
			renderer.render(scene, camera)
			window.requestAnimationFrame(animate)
		animate(0)
		
		messages.push({role: "assistant", content: "TiffyTime Pro rendszer kész. Miben segíthetek?"})
		
	def renderMarkdown text
		return window.DOMPurify.sanitize(window.marked.parse(text))

	def scrollToBottom
		setTimeout(&,10) do
			if $feed then $feed.scrollTop = $feed.scrollHeight

	def sendMessage
		let text = inputText.trim()
		if !text and !currentFile then return
		
		if currentFile
			await uploadFile(currentFile)
			text = (text ? text + "\n" : "") + "[Fájl csatolva: {currentFile.name}]"
			currentFile = null
			
		messages.push({role: "user", content: text})
		inputText = ""
		scrollToBottom()
		
		const aiMsg = {role: "assistant", content: "", loading: yes}
		messages.push(aiMsg)
		scrollToBottom()
		
		try
			const res = await window.fetch('/api/chat', {
				method: 'POST',
				headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
				body: JSON.stringify({messages: messages.filter(do |m| !m.loading), session_id: sessionId})
			})
			
			const reader = res.body.getReader()
			const decoder = new TextDecoder()
			aiMsg.loading = no
			
			while true
				const {done, value} = await reader.read()
				if done then break
				const chunk = decoder.decode(value)
				const lines = chunk.split('\n')
				for line in lines
					if line.startsWith('data: ')
						try
							const jsonStr = line.substring(6)
							if jsonStr.trim() === '[DONE]' then continue
							const data = JSON.parse(jsonStr)
							if data.content
								aiMsg.content += data.content
								imba.commit()
								scrollToBottom()
						catch e
							console.error e
		catch e
			aiMsg.content = "Hiba: " + e.message
		
	def uploadFile file
		const fd = new FormData()
		fd.append('file', file)
		messages.push({role: "assistant", content: "Fájl feltöltése: {file.name}..."})
		try
			const res = await window.fetch('/api/upload', {method: 'POST', body: fd})
			const data = await res.json()
			if data.success
				messages.push({role: "assistant", content: "✅ Siker. Elemzés: " + data.analysis})
			else
				messages.push({role: "assistant", content: "❌ Hiba: " + data.error})
		catch e
			messages.push({role: "assistant", content: "❌ Hiba: " + e.message})
			
	def handleFile e
		if e.target.files[0]
			currentFile = e.target.files[0]
			ctxVisible = no
			
	def triggerResearch
		ctxVisible = no
		inputText = ""
		const goal = window.prompt("Mi a kutatás célja?")
		if !goal then return
		
		try
			const res = await window.fetch('/api/research/create', {
				method: 'POST',
				headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
				body: JSON.stringify({goal})
			})
			const data = await res.json()
			if data.task_id
				messages.push({
					role: "assistant", 
					widget: {id: data.task_id, goal, status: "Inicializálás...", progress: 0}
				})
				pollTask(data.task_id)
		catch e
			console.error e

	def pollTask id
		if activeTasks.has(id) then return
		activeTasks.add(id)
		const interval = setInterval(&, 2000) do
			try
				const res = await window.fetch("/api/research/?task_id={id}")
				const data = await res.json()
				const msg = messages.find(do |m| m.widget and m.widget.id === id)
				if msg
					msg.widget.status = data.status
					msg.widget.progress = data.progress
					imba.commit()
				if data.status === 'Befejezve' or data.progress === 100
					clearInterval(interval)
					activeTasks.delete(id)
			catch e
				console.error e

	def openReport id
		try
			const res = await window.fetch("/api/research/?task_id={id}")
			reportData = await res.json()
			overlayActive = yes
		catch e
			console.error e
			
	def startNewChat
		sessionId = "session_" + Date.now()
		messages = []
		messages.push({role: "assistant", content: "Új munkamenet."})
		sidebarActive = no

	<self>
		<canvas$canvasBg>
		<div.app-frame>
			<div.sidebar .active=sidebarActive>
				<div.sidebar-header>
					<div.brand-text> "TiffyTime Pro"
				<div.new-chat-btn @click=startNewChat>
					<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
						<line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19">
						<line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12">
					<span> "Új Kutatás"
				<div.history-list>
					for chat in chats
						<div.history-item> chat.title
						
			<div.main-stage>
				<button.menu-toggle @click=(sidebarActive=!sidebarActive)> "☰"
				<div$feed.chat-feed>
					for msg in messages
						<div.msg-group classes=(msg.role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'ai')>
							<div.msg-meta> (msg.role === 'user' ? 'Én' : 'TiffyTime AI')
							if msg.widget
								<div.research-widget @click=openReport(msg.widget.id)>
									<div.rw-header>
										<span> "KUTATÁS"
										<span> msg.widget.status
									<div.rw-title> msg.widget.goal
									<div.rw-progress-bg>
										<div.rw-progress-fill style="width:{msg.widget.progress}%">
							else
								<div.msg-bubble innerHTML=renderMarkdown(msg.content)>
								
				<div.input-dock>
					<div.input-capsule>
						<button.icon-btn @click=(ctxVisible=!ctxVisible)>
							<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
								<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10">
								<line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16">
								<line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12">
						<div style="flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column">
							if currentFile
								<div.attachment-pill>
									<span> "📎 {currentFile.name}"
									<span style="cursor:pointer;margin-left:5px" @click=(currentFile=null)> "×"
							<textarea bind=inputText placeholder="Írj üzenetet..." rows=1 @keydown.enter.prevent=sendMessage>
						<button.icon-btn @click=sendMessage>
							<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
								<line x1="22" y1="2" x2="11" y2="13">

					<div.ctx-item @click=triggerResearch>
						<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
							<circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8">
							<line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65">
						<span> "Mély kutatás"
					<label.ctx-item>
						<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
							<path d="M21.44 11.05l-9.19 9.19a6 6 0 0 1-8.49-8.49l9.19-9.19a4 4 0 0 1 5.66 5.66l-9.2 9.19a2 2 0 0 1-2.83-2.83l8.49-8.48">
						<span> "Fájl csatolása"

		<div.overlay-view .active=overlayActive>
